latest.title: AWS Machine Learning 20 Exam Questions: Domain 1 Data Preparation [Set 1]
latest.description: AWS tools optimize ML data pipelines. Amazon Data Firehose ingests real-time streams, AWS DataSync moves on-premises data, and AWS Step Functions orchestrates workflows. For storage, Apache Parquet improves Amazon Athena queries, Amazon EFS shares files, and Amazon FSx for Lustre handles distributed training. AWS Glue DataBrew cleans data visually, AWS Glue Data Quality checks schemas, and Amazon Macie discovers PII. SageMaker Feature Store manages features, while encoding, resampling handle data anomalies.

latest.title: AI Agent

latest.title: How to Restrict IAM User Console Access Using Service Control Policies in AWS Organizations Member Accounts
latest.description:
Account administrators in AWS Organizations member accounts can create IAM users with console passwords, creating an uncontrolled access path that bypasses centralized SSO and MFA standards. 

This article explains how to use a Service Control Policy (SCP) to prevent IAM users from being granted AWS Management Console access, while preserving their ability to function as service principals with programmatic access.

latest.title: Amazon Cognito Resource Server Sprawl: The M2M Anti-Pattern to Avoid
latest.description: If you're creating a dedicated Amazon Cognito resource server for each tenant or environment in your M2M (machine-to-machine) architecture, you're building a pattern that won't scale. This post walks through why, and gives you three concrete alternatives that are architecturally sound and will scale with your needs.

latest.title: DynamoDB Zero-ETL Integration with Amazon Redshift: Bridging NoSQL and Analytics 📊
latest.description: "We might need reporting later." If you've been following the NoSQL Launchpad, you know this is one of the most dangerous phrases in NoSQL design. NoSQL databases are optimized for operational workloads—fast reads and writes with known access patterns. Analytics and reporting? That's traditionally been a different world, requiring complex ETL pipelines to move data from your operational database into a data warehouse.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
